chunks: Now, whoever among them adheres to this will be saved by Allāh from ruin, and whoever shows obstinacy and insistence (on wrong) is the reverser whose heart has been blinded by Allāh and evils will encircle his head.

key_terms.الرَّاكِسُ: the one who is reversed or turned back
key_terms.رَانَ: to cover or seal over (the heart)

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between those who are saved from ruin and those whose hearts are sealed according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In the context of the Siffin conflict, Imam Ali uses this passage to contrast the steadfastness of the loyalists with the obstinacy of the Khawarij or Umayyad forces, framing their fate through Quranic imagery of divine sealing. The description of the 'ring of evil' upon the head alludes to the concept of *khatm* (sealing) on the heart, indicating a spiritual stagnation resulting from persistent rejection of truth after it has been made clear.
